# The golden files in golden/ were generated by the original, unmodified EEFS release built -m32
# on i386 Linux, from the inputs in data/ with a fixed timestamp.  The current tools must
# reproduce them byte for byte.

set(EEFS_TEST_RUNNER ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/run_test.cmake)
set(EEFS_TEST_ARGS
    -DGENEEPROMFS=$<TARGET_FILE:geneepromfs>
    -DEEFSTOOL=$<TARGET_FILE:eefstool-img>
    -DDATA_DIR=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/data
    -DGOLDEN_DIR=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/golden)

foreach(test geneepromfs_big geneepromfs_little geneepromfs_map eefstool_read)
    add_test(NAME ${test}
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} ${EEFS_TEST_ARGS}
            -DEEFS_TEST=${test}
            -DWORK_DIR=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${test}
            -P ${EEFS_TEST_RUNNER})
endforeach()
